notes: Card flags the pole broad and gate-closed (100% leak regime); top examples are all single lowercase letters or short words right after '.⏎'. Probes: lowercase line starts 0.61-0.94; the same line capitalised 0.18 and 0.01; no line break 0.00. Near misses capitalise the line start or drop the break.
